member.name: OdooQuery
member.summary: Query for Odoo search_read / search_count: filters (domain), returned fields, order, offset and limit. Prefer typed , which maps .NET properties to Odoo field names.

member.name: OdooQuery.ctor
member.summary: Creates empty query - all records, all fields, default Odoo order.

member.name: OdooQuery.Filters
member.summary: Conditions of the query (Odoo domain). Empty means all records.

member.name: OdooQuery.ReturnFields
member.summary: Odoo field names to return. Empty means all fields - which can be slow for models with many computed fields.

member.name: OdooQuery.Offset
member.summary: Number of records to skip (for paging). Null means no offset.

member.name: OdooQuery.Limit
member.summary: Maximum number of returned records. Null means no limit.

member.name: OdooQuery.Order
member.summary: Order in Odoo syntax: comma separated "{odoo_field} ASC" or "{odoo_field} DESC", e.g. "name ASC, id DESC". Null uses the default order of the model.

member.name: OdooQueryOfT
member.summary: Typed query for records of : filters, fields and order are given by property expressions (x => x.Name) and translated to Odoo field names from [JsonProperty]. Pass it to . Methods modify this query and return it for chaining.

member.name: OdooQueryOfT.ctor
member.summary: Creates empty query - all records, all fields, default Odoo order.

member.name: OdooQueryOfT.Filters
member.summary: Typed conditions of the query (Odoo domain). Empty means all records.

member.name: OdooQueryOfT.Create
member.summary: Creates empty query - same as the constructor, convenient for chaining.

member.name: OdooQueryBuilder
member.summary: Fluent query for records of , created by . Chain filters, ordering, paging and field selection, then execute it with , , and others. Executing does not change the builder, so it can be executed again.
member.typeparam: Model class with and [JsonProperty] on properties.

member.name: Select.Selector
member.summary: Returns only fields of properties used in an anonymous object, e.g. Select(x => new { x.Name, x.Email }). Other properties of returned records stay default. Field id is always returned by Odoo.
member.param: Anonymous object with properties of ; properties are matched by name.

member.name: Select.Fields
member.summary: Returns only given Odoo fields, e.g. Select("name", "email"). Field id is always returned by Odoo.

member.name: SelectSimplifiedModel
member.summary: Returns only fields that exist as properties in , instead of all fields of the Odoo model. Recommended for big models - Odoo does not compute fields you don't need.

member.name: Where.Filter
member.summary: Adds conditions built with or , e.g. with Or(), In, Between. Conditions added by several Where calls are joined with AND.

member.name: Where.Expression
member.summary: Adds condition on a property, e.g. Where(x => x.Name, OdooOperator.EqualsTo, "Test"). Conditions added by several Where calls are joined with AND.
member.param: Compared value; use false to compare with an empty Odoo value.
member.exception: Expression does not select a property with [JsonProperty].

member.name: Where.ForeignKeyLevel1
member.summary: Adds condition on a field of a related record (many2one), e.g. partners from Poland: Where<ResCountryOdooModel>(x => x.CountryId, c => c.Code, OdooOperator.EqualsTo, "PL") gives Odoo condition country_id.code = 'PL'.
member.param: Compared property of the related record.

member.name: Where.ForeignKeyLevel2
member.summary: Adds condition on a field of a record related through two many2one fields, e.g. partners whose country uses PLN: Where<ResCountryOdooModel, ResCurrencyOdooModel>(x => x.CountryId, c => c.CurrencyId, cur => cur.Name, OdooOperator.EqualsTo, "PLN") gives Odoo condition country_id.currency_id.name = 'PLN'.
member.typeparam: Model of the first related record.
Model of the second related record.
member.param: Compared property of the second related record.

member.summary: Adds condition id = .

member.name: WithContext
member.summary: Uses given Odoo context for this query instead of (e.g. other language or company).
member.param: Context values; a copy is stored, so later changes of are not used.

member.param: Context key, e.g. lang, active_test, allowed_company_ids.

member.name: Skip
member.summary: Skips first records (Odoo offset). Use together with an order to get stable pages.

member.name: OrderBy
member.summary: Orders records ascending by the property. Replaces previous ordering.

member.name: OrderByDescending
member.summary: Orders records descending by the property. Replaces previous ordering.

member.name: ThenOrderBy

member.name: ThenOrderByDescending

member.name: ToListAsync
member.summary: Executes the query (Odoo search_read) and returns all matching records.
member.returns: Matching records (empty array when nothing matches), or failed result with Odoo error.

member.name: FirstAsync
member.summary: Executes the query with limit 1 and returns the first record.
member.returns: First matching record, or failed result with Odoo error.
member.exception: No record matches (like LINQ First) - use to get null instead.

member.name: FirstOrDefaultAsync
member.summary: Executes the query with limit 1 and returns the first record, or null when nothing matches.
member.returns: First matching record or null, or failed result with Odoo error.

member.name: SingleAsync
member.summary: Executes the query with limit 2 and returns the only matching record.
member.returns: The matching record, or failed result with Odoo error.
member.exception: No record or more than one record matches (like LINQ Single).

member.name: CountAsync
member.summary: Counts matching records (Odoo search_count) without reading them. Order, offset and limit are ignored.
member.returns: Number of matching records, or failed result with Odoo error.

member.name: AnyAsync
member.summary: Checks whether any record matches (reads at most one record).
member.returns: true when at least one record matches, or failed result with Odoo error.
